title: Static Trades
description: Avoid the hassle of cycling villagers by having static villager trades
body:
A configurable static-trades system balanced and built for the Block4Block game mode, fully open source and ready for you to customize every trade to match your server’s balance and style.

NOTE: _All trades are currently hardcoded in TradeManager.java, so, to modify trades, edit the Java source code and recompile.
Support for config-based trade customization is planned. Follow to be notified._
